name: Keros
title: Temple Servant After the Exile
summary: Keros is mentioned as the ancestor of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. His descendants are listed among those who came back with Zerubbabel to rebuild the temple and restore worship in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Temple Servants in Ezra's Record
keyEvents.description: Keros' descendants are mentioned among the temple servants (Nethinim) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem after the exile, as recorded in the book of Ezra.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Temple Servants in Nehemiah's Record
keyEvents.description: Keros' descendants are again mentioned among the temple servants in Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from captivity.

keyEvents.title: Return of the Temple Servants to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Along with other families of temple servants, Keros' descendants returned to serve at the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem and support the priests and Levites in their duties.

keyEvents.title: Registration of Returning Families
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah carried out a thorough registration of all families that had returned from exile, including the temple servant families to which Keros' lineage belonged.
